headline: Marban Hollow Records Only Fresh Base Change; Other Fronts Hold
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Marban Hollow has been the sole sector to record fresh strategic-base events, logging two in the past six hours with its latest at 10:01; the front remains divided, three Warden posts to five Colonial, and casualties on both sides are climbing. DeadLands, the last edition's pacesetter, has gone quiet at the flips counter yet still bleeds heavily, with both armies suffering more than 2,900 casualties in six hours. Drowned Vale and Stema Landing stay silent, while Endless Shore retains the war's largest 24-hour event ledger at forty-two, though none since 03:32. Farranac Coast and Weathered Expanse report no fresh base changes but heavy, quickening fire, the latter taking nearly two thousand casualties in two hours. Stlican Shelf and Clahstra show past-day churn but have paused in the latest window.
